Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

Ministries/Departments/ Borrowing Organizations may extend deputation tenure up to .7 years in cases of deputations covered by OM, dated the 17th June, 2010, subject to fulfilment of terms and conditions, with effect from 17-2-2016. The above provision is not applicable to CVOs in CPSEs and other Organizati.ons under Ministries / Departments as they are governed under separate guidelines. - Order (5), Section I, Appendix 5.
